plan: Drive: from District of Tumbler Ridge, about 59 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.43495, -121.08061, where the truck road ends (Puggins Rp - K); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.7 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 340 m W, climb about 3 m.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-21, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-25, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BA-moose-atv-0001.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-21: about 2,946 hunter days a year for moose (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.44 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 3 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
